title: introduce-regional-failover-sequencer-with-probe-hysteresis-and-emergency-rollback
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Fix: Add a sequencer gate for regional failover probes to reduce cascading circuit flips; runtime emergency rollback flag added for operators.
description: Motivation: Recent incidents showed probe storms during regional distress can trigger simultaneous circuit transitions, causing wide blast radius and prolonged recovery. This hotfix introduces a lightweight 'sequencer' that serializes failover probe actions per-region with jittered hysteresis windows, plus an operator-accessible emergency rollback flag and explicit migration steps. Design summary: 1) Sequencer actor (runtime/failover/sequencer.go) enqueues region-level failover transitions and enforces a soft token bucket to pace probe-triggered transitions. 2) Probe hysteresis: probes must observe a stable degraded window for configurable 'stable_window_ms' before the sequencer will escalate to circuit open. 3) Short-circuit emergency rollback: a runtime feature flag (runtime/flags/rollback_enable) that, when set by ops, forces all sequencer decisions to rewind to previous circuit states within a bounded reconciliation loop (max 2s). 4) Observability: add new metrics (regional_sequencer_queue_seconds, sequencer_decision_count, sequencer_rollback_invocations) and logs with op-friendly correlation IDs. 5) Safety: idempotent state transitions and added unit/integration tests to avoid double-apply races. Changes included: code, small config surface (defaults), deploy patch and ops doc. Checklist: - [x] add sequencer actor and queueing primitives - [x] add probe hysteresis and backoff policy - [x] add emergency rollback runtime flag and reconciliation loop - [x] add metrics and tracing spans - [x] add unit + k8s integration tests - [x] add ops doc and rollback playbook Rollout plan: staged rollout to canary region for 24h with observability dashboard (dashboards/ops/regional-failover.json); monitor sequencer_decision_count and error budgets. If abnormal, flip runtime flag to true to perform emergency rollback. Backwards compatibility: sequencer is opt-in via feature flag at startup; default settings are conservative to avoid reactionary behavior. Related: ENG-3421 (incident follow-up), ENG-3478 (SLO enforcement tuning). Migration notes: operators should apply the hotfix k8s patch and verify the runtime flag endpoint before enabling in production. Hotfix urgency: high — mitigates immediate risk of cascading circuit flips under probe storms.
